name: error-memory
title_zh: 同一坑掉三次前，先翻这本错误账
tagline_zh: 命令报错、方案被否、绕路成功——每次教训都记进 .learnings/。下次任务自动翻旧账。
tagline_en: Every failed command, rejected approach, and hard-won workaround lands in .learnings/. Next task auto-checks the.
desc_en: Prevent repeated mistakes by reviewing and recording verified errors, corrections, and project-specific gotchas in .learnings/. Use when a task may repeat earlier work, a command or tool fails, the user corrects an approach, or a reliable workaround is discovered.
why_zh: 不是笔记，是带触发条件的教训库。只在任务可能重蹈覆辙时调出对应条目，把「我记得」变成「系统记得」。
why_en: Not a notebook—a trigger-conditioned lesson bank. It surfaces relevant entries only when a task risks repeating past failures.
limit_zh: 只认文本型教训，不解析代码 diff 或日志。需要你主动确认错误才算数；没写进 .learnings/ 的坑。
limit_en: Text-only lessons; no code-diff or log parsing. Mistakes count only if you confirm them. Unrecorded pitfalls stay invisible—it won't save you from.
title_en: Error ledger that stops you repeating the same mistake
